title: Caramel Sugar Boil
description: A simple and sweet treat made with caramel, sugar, and boiled water. It's a perfect dessert to satisfy your sweet tooth!
instructions: Combine 2 cups of granulated sugar and 1 cup of boiled water in a saucepan.
Place the saucepan over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Increase the heat to high and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and slowly pour in 1 cup of caramel sauce.
Let the mixture cool and set at room temperature.
Once set, break the mixture into small pieces and serve.
